title: Planning OC pair commission (Scott + Shard)
content:
I'm planning on commissioning an artist to make a commission of my OC Scott (my oc in the artwork) and Shard snowcat like this together.

as someone who lives around cats and loves cats, i can't help but see myself petting shard like this. Yeah, Shard has sex appeal, but whenever i look at artwork of her, i just feel like "i wanna give her headpats and treat her like a spoiled cat".

I'd picture Scott and Shard having a relationship like Kisuke and Yoruichi from bleach, i might use him as a human sonic oc.
